newsitem.title: UK: Spate of new sugar freight orders seen at end-week.
newsitem.headline: Spate of new sugar freight orders seen at end-week.

text.p: London's sugar freight market was peppered with fresh enquiry at the end of the week amid a variety of quoted origins, shipbrokers said on Friday.
Tate & Lyle quoted for 18,000 tonnes of bulk sugar from Barbados to London for mid-March and also fixed a further 10,000 tonnes from Maceio to Finland at a rate thought to be in the high $30 bracket.
Sucre Export was in the market for 13/13,500 tonnes of bagged sugar from Continent to Mediterranean/Black Sea for 1/12 March.
Cargill quoted for 16/20,000 tonnes of bulk sugar from Rio Haina to US Gulf/Atlantic and Jean Lion was open for a prompt 14,000-tonne bulk cargo from Cuba to Syria.

Shipbrokers said Seven Seas quoted for 10,000 tonnes of bagged sugar from Thailand to Colombo with options of east Africa and Red Sea for prompt dates and Booker was seeking tonnage to ship 9/9,500 tonnes in bulk from St Kitts to UK/Nantes for 7/12 March.
